contributions_who.name: contributions_who
contributions_who.value: "contributions"."contributor_id" IS NOT NULL OR "contributions"."guest_name" IS NOT NULL

contributions_what.name: contributions_what
contributions_what.value: ("contributions"."amount_cents" IS NOT NULL AND "contributions"."amount_cents" > 0) OR ("contributions"."units" IS NOT NULL AND "contributions"."units" > 0)

share_links_open_list.name: share_links_open_list
share_links_open_list.value: "share_links"."open_token" IS NULL OR ("share_links"."scope" = 'list' AND "share_links"."list_id" IS NOT NULL)

share_links_target.name: share_links_target
share_links_target.value: ("share_links"."scope" = 'list' AND "share_links"."list_id" IS NOT NULL AND "share_links"."event_id" IS NULL) OR ("share_links"."scope" = 'event' AND "share_links"."event_id" IS NOT NULL AND "share_links"."list_id" IS NULL)
